name: Same-category advantage
fact: Categorical relationships among objects can expand the capacity of visual working memory by enabling the grouping of same-category objects.

provenance.title: Same-category advantage on the capacity of visual working memory
provenance.quote_or_locus: In conclusion, our data clearly demonstrate an advantageous same-category effect on the capacity of VWM, which indicates that categorical relationships among objects play an important role in expanding the capacity of VWM by enabling the grouping of same-category objects
